output.reason: The linked PR [ev-88e25659b93d] gives what the one-line note [ev-e7ec4045554f] leaves out. Subject: the observed generation in the status conditions of XRs and claims. Change: before this fix, the generation was never persisted to the API server; now it is. Consequence: without the fix, the condition equality check in MarkCondition fails, so conditions get a new LastTransitionTime on every reconcile. The changed files [ev-d3490a23ca3f] show the fix is in the generated XR/claim CRD schema (internal/xcrd/schemas.go), so it applies to every XR and claim, and the operator doesn't need to do anything.
